sentences.text: IPMA lists 32 active weather warnings in 25 areas of Portugal, 8 orange and 24 yellow.
Orange or red warnings for rain are active in Aveiro, Braga, Coimbra, Guarda, Porto, Viana do Castelo, Viseu and Vila Real.
Porto has a 100% chance of rain today, with a maximum of 16.6 °C.
Coimbra has a 98% chance of rain today, with a maximum of 16.8 °C.
Faro has a 0% chance of rain today, with a maximum of 18 °C.
Lisboa has a 37% chance of rain today, with a minimum of 13.3 °C and a maximum of 17.5 °C.
IPMA rates the fire risk as low for all 278 municipalities today.
On 2026-11-21, the Porto coast is forecast to have waves of 0.5 to 2.4 metres from W and sea temperatures of 16.6 to 16.8 °C.
